title: A loop route from where you are
description: The proposed path can be checked in advance, and the cues can be listened to during the run.

blocks.text: Somewhere unfamiliar, the user is counting on getting back to the start. If guidance does not resume after going off course, the problem remains even when the loop itself was built well.

quote.text: It won't course correct. It won't tell you when you are off course. And the worst is once you get back on course it will no longer give you turn by turn directions. Imagine traveling for work, getting in a workout and being lost.
quote.app: RunGo - The Best Routes to Run

blocks.text: Test the return to the route
Before the start, show the whole path and where it begins. While moving, mark a deviation, offer a way to carry on and resume the cues once the runner is back. Keep the map available at any moment.
A calculated line does not confirm that the path is passable now. But the app can say clearly whether it is still guiding along the route and which point the next cue refers to.
